boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Allegheny College
boards.description: Late-night dining at Allegheny College is defined by a mix of on-campus food courts, 24/7 convenience markets, and local Meadville staples that have served students for decades.

cards.title: McKinley's Food Court
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Campus Hub
cards.notes: Located in the Henderson Campus Center, this food court stays open until 12:30 AM on weekends, serving burgers, fries, and pizza to students.
cards.short_summary: The primary late-night dining destination on campus, featuring multiple food stations and mobile ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: McKinley's Food Court is open until 10:30 PM Monday-Thursday and Sunday, and until 12:30 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Dining | Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:30 AM on Friday and Saturday; 10:30 PM other nights.

cards.title: 360 Market
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience in Brooks Hall
cards.notes: This self-checkout market in Brooks Hall provides 24/7 access to snacks, beverages, and grocery staples for residential students.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 on-campus convenience store offering grab-and-go meals and household essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: The 360 Market is a 24/7 convenience store located in Brooks Hall.
cards.source_title: Dining | Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for students with campus ID.

cards.title: Grounds for Change
cards.subtitle: Student-Run Coffeehouse
cards.notes: A student-run, non-profit coffeehouse in the Campus Center that serves as a late-night study and social space until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A volunteer-run coffeehouse known for its sustainable practices and alcohol-free social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Grounds for Change is open until 12:00 AM Monday through Thursday and on Sunday.
cards.source_title: Commuter Amenities - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM most nights; closes at 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Sheetz
cards.subtitle: The 24/7 MTO Classic
cards.notes: A regional staple where students go for Made-To-Order (MTO) burgers, fries, and snacks at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and kitchen that serves as a primary off-campus late-night food source.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz offers Made-To-Order food and beverages 24/7/365.
cards.source_title: Sheetz Official Website
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru
cards.notes: The Park Avenue location is a go-to for late-night cravings, with a drive-thru that stays open until 4:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain near campus known for its extremely late drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1228 Park Ave in Meadville is open until 4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Meadville, PA - 1228 Park Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 4:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Delivery Staple
cards.notes: A reliable delivery option for students studying late, with service extending until 2:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: The local Domino's provides late-night pizza delivery and carryout to the Allegheny campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Domino's on Willow Street is open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza Meadville
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; 1:00 AM other nights.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Diner
cards.notes: A classic 24-hour diner that serves as an off-campus study spot with bottomless coffee and full breakfast menus.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 diner popular for late-night study sessions and group meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's is a 24-hour diner and breakfast restaurant.
cards.source_title: Denny's Official Website
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fast Food
cards.notes: The Park Avenue McDonald's offers late-night drive-thru service, providing a quick meal option for students near campus.
cards.short_summary: A standard late-night fast-food option with extended drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 1060 Park Ave offers late-night drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: McDonald's Meadville, PA - 1060 Park Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open late; check app for specific nightly closing times.

cards.title: Food Resource Center
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Student Pantry
cards.notes: A student-led initiative providing 24/7 access to refrigerated produce and dry goods for any student in need.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 food pantry on the third floor of the Campus Center aimed at combating food insecurity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Food Resource Center is a 24/7 resource for students located on the third floor of the campus center.
cards.source_title: Food Resource Center opens with fridge, food staples - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 whenever the Campus Center is accessible.

cards.title: Hank's Frozen Custard
cards.subtitle: Seasonal Evening Tradition
cards.notes: A seasonal Meadville tradition since 1952, students visit for fresh-made frozen custard until 11:00 PM during the summer.
cards.short_summary: A historic local custard stand that is a popular evening destination for students during the warmer months.
cards.evidence_claim: Hank's Frozen Custard is open until 11:00 PM daily from Memorial Day to the end of the season.
cards.source_title: Hank's Frozen Custard - Explore PA History
cards.access_notes: Open seasonally; 11:00 PM closing time during peak summer months.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, student-run hubs, and quiet outdoor retreats that define the daily student experience at Allegheny College.

cards.title: Student-Run Coffeehouse Hub
cards.subtitle: Henderson Campus Center, Second Floor
cards.notes: Visit this volunteer-run spot for fair-trade coffee and milkshakes. It serves as a central social hub for studying and community events in an alcohol-free environment.
cards.short_summary: A student-managed, non-profit coffeehouse focused on sustainability and community gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Grounds for Change is a volunteer and student-run coffeehouse located on the second floor of the Henderson Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Clubs and Organizations - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typical hours are 8 AM to midnight on weekdays with weekend variations.

cards.title: Upper Floor Writing Retreat
cards.subtitle: Pelletier Library, Third Floor
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for this dedicated community writing and meeting space. It offers a focused environment away from the busier main floor traffic.
cards.short_summary: A specialized classroom and meeting space on the library's upper floor used for collaborative writing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collaboratory is located on the upper floor of Pelletier Library and serves as a classroom and meeting space.
cards.source_title: Pelletier Library Floor Maps and Directions - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library operating hours; some sessions may be reserved for specific groups.

cards.title: Sustainable Teaching Garden
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Carr Hall
cards.notes: Explore this 3,000-square-foot garden where students grow organic produce. It features an experimental greenhouse that generates its own solar power.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on learning garden and solar-powered greenhouse producing food for campus dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Carr Hall Garden is a nearly 3,000 square foot teaching garden with an experimental, power-generating greenhouse.
cards.source_title: Carr Hall Garden - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden area is generally viewable; greenhouse access is typically for classes and volunteers.

cards.title: Vukovich Center Green Roof
cards.subtitle: Vukovich Center for Communication Arts
cards.notes: Walk along cedar walkways through lavender and native trees on this rooftop garden. It functions as a sustainable stormwater management system and quiet retreat.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped green roof terrace featuring native plants and scenic campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: Laura's Rooftop Terrace is a green roof garden with cedar walkways and native plants atop the Vukovich Center.
cards.source_title: Sustainability: Water - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community during building hours; accessible via the Vukovich Center.

cards.title: Historic Student Gathering Space
cards.subtitle: Brooks Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this recently renovated lounge for studying and social justice dialogue. It honors the first Black graduate of Allegheny College.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated space for inclusion and social justice engagement located within Brooks Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The William C. Jason Diversity Lounge in Brooks Hall was renovated and renamed in February 2023.
cards.source_title: Diversity lounge renamed, renovated - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Located in Brooks Hall; accessible to students for study and organized IDEAS Center programming.

cards.title: Sunset View Dance Space
cards.subtitle: Montgomery Performance Space
cards.notes: Visit the upper studio in 'Monty' for a peaceful atmosphere and expansive sunset views through large windows. It is a favorite for yoga and movement.
cards.short_summary: An elevated dance and movement studio known for its tranquil environment and scenic views.
cards.evidence_claim: The upper studio in Montgomery Performance Space is noted by students for its sunset views and peaceful atmosphere.
cards.source_title: Inside 'Monty' - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; primarily used for dance and movement studies classes.

cards.title: Third Floor Natural Light Nook
cards.subtitle: Henderson Campus Center, Third Floor
cards.notes: Find this quiet lounge on the top floor of the Campus Center. It offers natural light from above, making it an ideal spot for focused reading.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, naturally lit study lounge located on the third floor of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Skylight Lounge is listed as a facility on the third floor of the Henderson Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Campus Center and Store - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open during Henderson Campus Center hours (typically 6 AM to midnight or 1 AM).

cards.title: Central Outdoor Activity Hub
cards.subtitle: Center of Campus
cards.notes: Gather on this central green space for orientation activities, club fairs, and casual outdoor studying. It serves as the primary outdoor crossroads for students.
cards.short_summary: The main campus quadrangle used for major student events and daily recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gator Quad is a central campus location used for orientation activities and student organization events.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public campus outdoor space.

cards.title: Historic Outdoor Event Space
cards.subtitle: Near Bentley Hall
cards.notes: Visit this plaza featuring salvaged brick and historic lighting. While used for commencement, it offers a stately setting for outdoor group meetings.
cards.short_summary: A formal outdoor plaza integrated into the historic campus core for ceremonies and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Bicentennial Plaza is an outdoor event plaza located near the historic buildings of the campus core.
cards.source_title: Bicentennial Plaza - Allegheny College Events
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public campus outdoor space.

cards.title: Main Floor Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Pelletier Library, Main Floor
cards.notes: Access peer tutoring and academic coaching in this central library hub. It provides a collaborative environment with easy access to research librarians.
cards.short_summary: A holistic student support center offering tutoring and advising in a central library location.
cards.evidence_claim: The Maytum Center for Academic Success is located on the main floor of Pelletier Library.
cards.source_title: Maytum Center for Academic Success - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library hours; professional staff available during standard business hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Allegheny College, from on-campus galleries and game rooms to nearby nature reserves and community parks.

cards.title: Browse Contemporary Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Doane Hall of Art
cards.notes: Visit the Bowman, Penelec, and Megahan galleries to see contemporary art. All programs are free and open to the public during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A three-gallery complex in Doane Hall featuring contemporary art exhibitions and student senior projects with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: All programs at the Allegheny Art Galleries are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Art - Allegheny Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Friday 12:30-4pm, Saturday 1:30-5pm, and Sunday 2-4pm when the college is in session.

cards.title: Play Free Arcade Games
cards.subtitle: Henderson Campus Center, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Unwind with free-play arcade games, pool, and table tennis. You can also sign out board games for up to 48 hours at no cost.
cards.short_summary: A student social hub featuring Skee-Ball, air hockey, Nintendo Switch stations, and classic arcade cabinets all set to free-play.
cards.evidence_claim: All games in the Henderson Campus Center Game Room are set to free-play.
cards.source_title: Campus Center and Store | Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight during the academic year.

cards.title: Find a Quiet Study Spot
cards.subtitle: North Main Street
cards.notes: Use this historic 1902 chapel as a quiet space for reflection or study. It is open to students most weekdays and weekends.
cards.short_summary: A nonsectarian historic chapel providing a peaceful environment for meditation, prayer, or silent study for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel is open to students for a quiet place to pray or meditate from 7 am to 11 pm weekdays and 7 am to 5 pm weekends.
cards.source_title: Spiritual Spaces - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m. to 11 p.m. weekdays and 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. weekends unless reserved for events.

cards.title: Hike Through Native Woodlands
cards.subtitle: Oil Creek Road
cards.notes: Explore 283 acres of ponds and wetlands just east of campus. The reserve is open for limited recreational use like hiking and nature walks.
cards.short_summary: A college-owned forest used for environmental research that offers trails for students to explore local ecosystems and wildlife.
cards.evidence_claim: Bousson Environmental Research Reserve is reserved for research and some recreational use.
cards.source_title: Bousson Environmental Research Reserve - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Located approximately seven miles east of campus; open for daylight hiking.

cards.title: Access Government Documents
cards.subtitle: 520 North Main Street
cards.notes: Visit this federal depository library to access government records. Public access is guaranteed by law during designated weekday hours.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library and a designated Federal Depository, offering public access to a vast collection of government publications.
cards.evidence_claim: Public access to government documents is guaranteed by public law at Pelletier Library.
cards.source_title: Library | Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Public access is typically available 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Friday.

cards.title: Watch Hot Air Balloons
cards.subtitle: Robertson Athletic Complex
cards.notes: Attend this annual June festival to see hot air balloon launches and night glows. Admission for spectators is free of charge.
cards.short_summary: A signature Meadville community event held at the college's athletic complex featuring balloon flights and family-friendly entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Thurston Classic is open to the public - FREE OF CHARGE!
cards.source_title: Event Details | Thurston Classic
cards.access_notes: Held annually in June; bring your own lawn chairs or blankets for seating.

cards.title: Attend a Summer Concert
cards.subtitle: Downtown Meadville
cards.notes: Walk downtown to this historic park for free summer concerts and community parades. It's a central gathering spot for students and locals.
cards.short_summary: A historic town square gifted to the city in 1795 that hosts various free public events, including seasonal concerts and festivals.
cards.evidence_claim: Diamond Park hosts summer concerts and parades that are open to the community.
cards.source_title: Virtual Introduction to Meadville | Community Engagement - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily; events are typically held during summer and fall months.

cards.title: Celebrate with Color
cards.subtitle: Gator Quad
cards.notes: Join the annual Holi festival on the central campus quad. This vibrant event involves throwing colored powder and is free for the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A popular spring tradition where students gather on the Gator Quad to celebrate the Hindu festival of colors with music and powder.
cards.evidence_claim: Holi brings a pop of color to the Gator Quad as a student-led campus event.
cards.source_title: Art gallery opening: Allegheny Alumni art exhibit - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Annual spring event; open to all Allegheny students.

cards.title: Join a Guided Bug Walk
cards.subtitle: Stainbrook Park
cards.notes: Participate in free environmental programs like bug walks and tree identification. Most events are open to all ages and require pre-registration.
cards.short_summary: An educational center offering free nature-based workshops and guided outdoor activities for the Crawford County community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crawford County Conservation District offers a wide variety of free educational programs at the Woodcock Creek Nature Center.
cards.source_title: Education | Crawford County Conservation District
cards.access_notes: Pre-registration is required for most programs by calling 814-763-5269.

cards.title: Socialize in the Central Lounge
cards.subtitle: 474 North Main Street
cards.notes: Gather with friends in the central first-floor lounge of this first-year residence hall. It's a primary social space for new students.
cards.short_summary: A large communal space in Baldwin Hall designed for student interaction, featuring seating and proximity to shared kitchens.
cards.evidence_claim: Baldwin Hall features a central first-floor lounge as an amenity for residents.
cards.source_title: Baldwin Hall | Residence Life - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Access is generally restricted to students with valid college ID cards.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From the historic quiet of Ruter Hall to the student-run energy of Grounds for Change, these ten study environments offer distinct physical setups for deep focus or group collaboration at Allegheny College.

cards.title: Pelletier Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Tech-Equipped Rooms
cards.notes: Reserve these rooms for up to two hours daily. They feature varying capacities and are designed specifically for group projects and collaborative sessions.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms in the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can reserve group study rooms in Pelletier during library hours for up to two hours per person per day.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Group Study Room | Library - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via online form or at the Library Services Desk; no food or drink allowed.

cards.title: Pelletier Library Study Cubicles
cards.subtitle: Semester-Long Quiet Carrels
cards.notes: Apply for a dedicated single-person carrel for the entire semester. These are located on the designated quiet floor for uninterrupted individual work.
cards.short_summary: Single-person carrels reservable for a full semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Cubicles are single-person study carrels that can be reserved for an entire semester on the library's designated quiet floor.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Cubicle | Library - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Granted on a first-come, first-served basis via application; located on the quiet floor.

cards.title: Grounds for Change
cards.subtitle: Student-Run Sustainable Coffeehouse
cards.notes: Study in a social, alcohol-free environment with second-hand furniture. This student-run space supports sustainable practices and intellectual discussion.
cards.short_summary: A student-run, sustainable coffeehouse and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Grounds for Change is a volunteer and student-run coffeehouse providing a location for socializing, studying, and intellectual discussion.
cards.source_title: Home | GFC - Wix.com
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Henderson Campus Center; open weekdays 8am-12am and Sundays 8am-11pm.

cards.title: Walker Hall Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Dedicated Commuter Work Space
cards.notes: Access this secure lounge featuring lockers, a refrigerator, and couches. It is specifically designed for commuter students to work and relax between classes.
cards.short_summary: A secure lounge for commuter students in Walker Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commuter Lounge in Walker Hall is a space for commuters to work and relax, featuring lockers, a refrigerator, and microwaves.
cards.source_title: Maytum Center for Academic Success - Commuter Amenities - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open 7am-7pm on weekdays; key card and code access required for entry.

cards.title: Ruter Hall Language Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Historic Reading Area
cards.notes: Utilize the small lounge and reading area on the third floor of this historic Greek Revival building. It includes workstations and printers for student use.
cards.short_summary: A quiet reading area in the historic Ruter Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Language Learning Center on the third floor of Ruter Hall includes a small lounge/reading area and two workstations with printers open to all students.
cards.source_title: World Languages and Cultures - Language Learning Center - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor; accessible during standard academic building hours.

cards.title: Carr Hall Physics Lounge
cards.subtitle: Science-Focused Study Hub
cards.notes: Find a welcoming lounge environment within the Physics department. This space is available to all students looking for a spot near the science labs.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge located in the Physics department of Carr Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Carr Hall, home to the Physics department, includes a welcoming lounge available to all students.
cards.source_title: Facilities and Strengths | Physics | Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during building hours; located within the Physics department area.

cards.title: William C. Jason Diversity Lounge
cards.subtitle: Renovated Inclusive Space
cards.notes: Study in this recently renovated lounge in Brooks Hall. It serves as a hub for interaction and collaboration, honoring the college's first Black graduate.
cards.short_summary: A renovated collaborative lounge in Brooks Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The William C. Jason Diversity Lounge in Brooks Hall was renovated and renamed in 2023 to promote interaction and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Diversity lounge renamed, renovated - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Located in Brooks Hall; open to the campus community for study and meetings.

cards.title: Gator Quad
cards.subtitle: Central Outdoor Gathering Spot
cards.notes: Use the Adirondack chairs and green space for outdoor study. This central hub is ideal for reading or casual group meetings in a vibrant campus setting.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor quad for student study and relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Gator Quad, outside the Campus Center, is a vibrant spot for students to meet, study, and relax, featuring Adirondack chairs.
cards.source_title: Caflisch site could reopen as soon as next week as ground settles - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; best used during daylight hours; features outdoor seating like Adirondack chairs.

cards.title: Vukovich Center Roof Garden
cards.subtitle: Elevated Green Study Space
cards.notes: Study on the accessible green roof of this modern facility. It offers a unique outdoor environment with views of the campus and Meadville.
cards.short_summary: An accessible green roof garden for outdoor study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Vukovich Center for Communication Arts features a green roof that is part of its sustainable design and accessible to the community.
cards.source_title: Allegheny College, Vukovich Center for Communication Arts - Ennead Architects
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Vukovich Center during building hours; subject to weather conditions.

cards.title: Campus Center Main Street
cards.subtitle: Active Hub Study Area
cards.notes: Find open tables in the main floor area for individual or group work. This high-traffic zone is perfect for those who prefer a more energetic background hum.
cards.short_summary: Open study tables on the main floor of the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henderson Campus Center is a space for intellectual conversation and study, with the main floor area available for use whenever the building is open.
cards.source_title: Campus Center and Store | Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 6am-midnight; Friday hours vary; no reservation required for tables.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential streets and corridors surrounding Allegheny College, from historic downtown hubs to the quiet residential blocks where students live and study.

cards.title: North Main Street
cards.subtitle: The Primary Campus Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this central artery to reach the North Village apartments or the college-owned houses that line the hill leading directly into the heart of campus.
cards.short_summary: The main north-south corridor connecting Allegheny College to the residential and commercial districts of Meadville.
cards.evidence_claim: North Main Street is identified as a primary location for college-owned houses and the North Village apartment community.
cards.source_title: Residence Halls - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare accessible 24/7; sidewalks connect campus directly to downtown.

cards.title: Chestnut Street
cards.subtitle: Downtown Commercial Hub
cards.notes: Visit this historic street to find local favorites like Tarot Bean Roasting Company and the Academy Theatre, just a short walk down the hill from campus.
cards.short_summary: A major commercial street in downtown Meadville featuring shops, cafes, and entertainment venues popular with students.
cards.evidence_claim: Chestnut Street is described as a historic business district with hotels, shops, and entertainment establishments like Tarot Bean Roasting Company.
cards.source_title: Tour | Downtown Meadville: Local Business Through the Years
cards.access_notes: Public street with metered parking; most businesses operate during standard daytime and evening hours.

cards.title: Park Avenue
cards.subtitle: Athletic and Residential Link
cards.notes: Follow this street to reach the Robertson Athletic Complex or the historic Walker Hall residence, which borders the western edge of the college grounds.
cards.short_summary: A key street bordering the campus that houses athletic facilities and upperclassman residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Park Avenue is the location for the Robertson Complex and Walker Hall residence hall.
cards.source_title: Campus Map/Directions - Allegheny College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Public street; athletic complex access depends on event schedules.

cards.title: Market Street
cards.subtitle: Home of the Market House
cards.notes: Stop by the historic Meadville Market House for local produce and artisan goods, or visit the Cattail Cafe for a quiet study spot off campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street known for the historic Market House and various local eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: Market Street hosts the Meadville Market House and businesses like Cattail Cafe.
cards.source_title: Meadville Market House
cards.access_notes: Public street; Market House is open Tuesday-Saturday with varying hours.

cards.title: Diamond Park
cards.subtitle: The Town's Central Square
cards.notes: Relax in this historic public square that serves as the center of Meadville, hosting community festivals and the seasonal Second Saturday markets.
cards.short_summary: The central public square of Meadville, serving as a community gathering point and event space.
cards.evidence_claim: Diamond Park is the public square at the center of Meadville's grid and hosts events like National Night Out.
cards.source_title: Diamond Park - City of Meadville
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Loomis Street
cards.subtitle: Special Interest Housing Row
cards.notes: Walk past these college-owned houses where students live in small communities focused on specific curricular or co-curricular interests.
cards.short_summary: A residential street on the campus periphery primarily used for Allegheny's Special Interest Housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Loomis Street is listed as a location for college-owned houses used for Special Interest Housing.
cards.source_title: College-Owned Houses | Residence Life
cards.access_notes: Residential street; house interiors are restricted to residents and guests.

cards.title: Water Street
cards.subtitle: The Historic Waterfront Road
cards.notes: Explore the western edge of downtown to find Valesky's grocery store and various service businesses along this former industrial corridor.
cards.short_summary: The earliest business district in Meadville, running parallel to French Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: Water Street is identified as the earliest business district in Meadville, paralleling the waterfront.
cards.source_title: Tour | Downtown Meadville: Local Business Through the Years
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; includes the Downtown Meadville Mall area.

cards.title: Highland Avenue
cards.subtitle: The Hilltop Neighborhood
cards.notes: Stroll through this leafy residential area to see historic early 20th-century homes and find popular off-campus student rentals.
cards.short_summary: A residential street known for its historic architecture and proximity to the college campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Highland Avenue is noted for its historic homes and its role in the Allegheny College neighborhood vibe.
cards.source_title: Campus and Area Maps - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; very walkable from the main campus.

cards.title: Arch Street
cards.subtitle: Downtown Residential Link
cards.notes: Find affordable student apartments and local pizza spots along this street that connects the downtown core to the southern residential wards.
cards.short_summary: A street south of the main campus area featuring a mix of residential housing and small local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Arch Street is a location for multiple apartment rentals and is described as very walkable to downtown amenities.
cards.source_title: 356 Arch Street - Meadville PA
cards.access_notes: Public street; primarily residential with some commercial storefronts.

cards.title: Pennsylvania Avenue
cards.subtitle: The Outskirts Retail Route
cards.notes: Drive just past the city limits to find unique local shops like The Boot Box and Touch of East for dorm decor and winter gear.
cards.short_summary: A road leading out of Meadville that hosts several specialized retail businesses frequented by students.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania Avenue is the location for student-recommended shops like Touch of East and The Boot Box.
cards.source_title: Intro to Meadville: These little known places get an A-plus from us
cards.access_notes: Public road; best accessed by car or bike as it is further from the central campus.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing traditions of Allegheny College, from the legendary 13th plank to the symbolic burning of the Senior Comp.

cards.title: Stealing the 13th Plank
cards.subtitle: A bridge of legends and missing wood
cards.notes: Locate the 13th plank on this historic wooden bridge. Tradition dictates that freshmen men steal it to prevent a jinx on their dating lives for the year.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark where students traditionally steal the 13th plank to ward off a social superstition.
cards.evidence_claim: Legend has it that if a freshman woman is kissed on the thirteenth plank by an upperclassman, the men of the freshmen class will remain dateless; subsequently, freshmen men steal the plank.
cards.source_title: A love letter to the Rustic Bridge - The Campus
cards.access_notes: The bridge is located in the lower ravine on the south side of campus and is accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Burning of the Comps
cards.subtitle: A fiery end to senior year research
cards.notes: Join seniors during Senior Week as they toss copies of their Senior Comprehensive Projects into a ceremonial bonfire to celebrate academic completion.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where graduating seniors burn copies of their required Senior Comprehensive Projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Burning of the Comps' is a College tradition dating back at least to the late 1800s, celebrating the conclusion of the seniors' academic work.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the Gator Quad or near Brooks Hall during Senior Week in May.

cards.title: Gator Day
cards.subtitle: Classes canceled for professional growth
cards.notes: Participate in this class-free day dedicated to workshops and community building. It often coincides with Election Day to encourage civic engagement.
cards.short_summary: An annual tradition where classes are canceled for a day of professional development and community activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Gator Day is an annual fall and spring tradition at Allegheny where classes are canceled, and students attend sessions designed for development.
cards.source_title: Gator Days - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Events take place across various campus buildings including the Henderson Campus Center.

cards.title: The Run Out
cards.subtitle: A spirited Greek life introduction
cards.notes: Watch as new members of fraternities and sororities 'run out' of Brooks Hall into the circle to be greeted by their organizations with cheers.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy event where Greek organizations introduce their newest members to the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Each fraternity and sorority introduces its new members at Run-Out; members 'run out' of Brooks Hall into Brooks Circle.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Occurs at the beginning of each semester in the circle outside Brooks Hall.

cards.title: Wingfest
cards.subtitle: The ultimate wing-eating competition
cards.notes: Head to the Gator Quad for the annual wing-eating contest and community feast featuring local Meadville flavors and themed festivities.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall festival centered around a competitive wing-eating contest and community dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingfest is an annual event hosted by Gator Activities Programming featuring a wing-eating competition and wings from local establishments.
cards.source_title: Wingfest 2025: Winner winner wing dinner - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the fall on the Gator Quad; open to all students.

cards.title: Competition of the Muses
cards.subtitle: Greek life performance showcase
cards.notes: Attend this choreographed performance event where Greek organizations compete in singing and dancing, formerly known as Greek Sing.
cards.short_summary: A traditional performance competition between fraternities and sororities held during Blue and Gold Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Competition of the Muses (formerly Greek Sing) involves fraternities and sororities performing choreographed songs and acts in Shafer Auditorium.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Weekend - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Henderson Campus Center; typically held on Friday evening of Blue and Gold Weekend.

cards.title: Senior Circle Legacy
cards.subtitle: Honoring the graduating class
cards.notes: Visit the monument where senior classes are recognized for their collective gift to the college, marking their transition to alumni status.
cards.short_summary: A physical monument on campus that records the legacy and contributions of each graduating senior class.
cards.evidence_claim: Senior classes who give are noted on the Senior Circle monument, representing their first legacy of giving to Allegheny College.
cards.source_title: Class Traditions at Allegheny | Maytum Center for Academic Success
cards.access_notes: Located near the top of Brooks Walk; accessible to the public.

cards.title: Matriculation Ceremony
cards.subtitle: The formal start of the journey
cards.notes: Witness the traditional welcome for first-year students as they are formally inducted into the Allegheny community of scholars.
cards.short_summary: The official ceremony marking the beginning of a student's academic career at Allegheny College.
cards.evidence_claim: Matriculation is the traditional beginning of students' academic journey at Allegheny College, serving as their formal welcome.
cards.source_title: Gator Week of Welcome Celebrates Community, Tradition - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Usually held in Ford Memorial Chapel or Shafer Auditorium during orientation week.

cards.title: Chompers the Gator
cards.subtitle: A mascot born from alliteration
cards.notes: Look for Chompers at athletic events. The alligator mascot was chosen in 1925 simply for the alliterative value of 'Allegheny Alligator.'
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of Allegheny College, representing a century-old student-led naming tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: The name 'Alligator' was selected in 1925 purely for the alliterative value; the current mascot is named Chompers.
cards.source_title: Alligator Evolution | Merrick Archives - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Appears at home games in the Wise Sport and Fitness Center and Robertson Athletic Complex.

cards.title: Springfest
cards.subtitle: The biggest weekend of the spring
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the academic year with a weekend of concerts, games, and themed activities organized by Gator Activities Programming.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring festival featuring major concerts and campus-wide celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Springfest is an annual Allegheny tradition featuring a weekend full of events, including a major concert in the Wise Center.
cards.source_title: GAP announces 'Super Springfest' events - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Events are held across campus, with the main concert typically in the Wise Center.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Allegheny College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Family Picnic on the Lawn
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Kickoff
cards.notes: Join the traditional family picnic on Caflisch Lawn to meet the college president and say your final goodbyes before orientation begins.
cards.short_summary: A traditional welcome picnic for new students and their families held on the lawn of Caflisch Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Family Picnic is held at Caflisch Lawn on the Friday of orientation weekend, followed by a Family Farewell.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and their families during orientation Friday afternoon.

cards.entity_name: David V. Wise Sport and Fitness Center
cards.title: The Class of 2030 Photo
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Tradition
cards.notes: Head to the Blue Courts at the Wise Center to gather with your entire incoming class for the official group photo.
cards.short_summary: New students gather at the Wise Center's Blue Courts for their first official class photograph.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 2030 Photo is scheduled for 5:45 pm on Friday at the Wise Center Blue Courts.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Required event for new students; typically held in the evening on the first Friday.

cards.title: Breakfast at Brooks
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Fuel
cards.notes: Meet your Orientation Leader for a buffet-style breakfast in this historic campus landmark before the day's sessions begin.
cards.short_summary: The primary all-you-care-to-eat dining hall where students gather for orientation meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation Leader meetings and breakfast are held at Brooks Dining Hall on Saturday morning starting at 9:30 am.
cards.source_title: University Dining Services | Allegheny | Home
cards.access_notes: Weekend breakfast/brunch hours are 10:30 am to 2:00 pm for general service.

cards.title: Required Student Sessions
cards.subtitle: Saturday Academic Intro
cards.notes: Attend rotations of required new student sessions in the library to learn about academic resources and campus life.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library serves as the hub for academic orientation sessions during the first weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Required New Student Sessions are held in rotations at Pelletier Library on Saturday from 9:00 am to 2:30 pm.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Library is used for orientation sessions; regular weekend hours vary by semester.

cards.title: The Classroom Quest
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Navigation
cards.notes: Take a self-guided walk through campus buildings to locate your specific classrooms before Monday's first bell.
cards.short_summary: A designated time for new students to explore campus and find their academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: Classroom Quest is a self-guided time from 3:30 pm to 5:00 pm on Saturday for students to find their classrooms.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Self-guided activity across all academic buildings on campus.

cards.title: Evening on the Gator Quad
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Social
cards.notes: Gather on the central quad for evening activities hosted by student organizations to meet your new classmates.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor gathering space on campus, used for social events and orientation activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation Leader meetings and opening activities are frequently held at the Gator Quad.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; primary site for outdoor student life events.

cards.title: Visit the Market House
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Outing
cards.notes: Walk downtown to the 'Heart of Meadville' for local produce, baked goods, and a taste of the local community.
cards.short_summary: A historic community market in downtown Meadville offering local food and artisan crafts.
cards.evidence_claim: The historic Meadville Market House is described as a destination for local goods and is within walking distance of campus.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; check seasonal hours for Sunday community markets.

cards.title: The Historic Bentley Hall
cards.subtitle: Sunday Campus Exploration
cards.notes: Visit the oldest building on campus to see the site where you will eventually march through the doors at graduation.
cards.short_summary: The iconic Federalist-style building that serves as the symbolic heart of Allegheny College.
cards.evidence_claim: Bentley Hall is the first building on campus and is central to the Commencement tradition where seniors march through its doors.
cards.source_title: History - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Exterior is viewable anytime; interior houses administrative offices.

cards.title: Dinner at McKinley's
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Meal
cards.notes: Grab a casual dinner at the Campus Center's food court, a popular spot for meeting friends before the first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: A retail-style food court located in the Henderson Campus Center offering various dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: McKinley's Food Court is located in the Campus Center and is open on Sundays from 11:00 am to 10:30 pm.
cards.source_title: University Dining Services | Allegheny | Home
cards.access_notes: Open late on Sundays until 10:30 pm for student dining.

cards.title: First Floor Meeting
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Wrap-up
cards.notes: Meet your Resident Assistant and neighbors to discuss community standards and upcoming hall events.
cards.short_summary: Mandatory meetings for residents to build community and learn hall policies.
cards.evidence_claim: Residence Hall Floor Meetings are held at 8:00 pm on the first Friday and recurringly to meet the community.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Held within individual residence halls for assigned residents.
